faqs.question: What is the selection process for BTech at Rajalakshmi Engineering College?
faqs.answer: In order to be eligible for the Rajalakshmi Engineering College BTech course, aspirants must meet the eligibility criteria. reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Overall a good college with good placements.

review_content.Placements: Placements of this college are above average. Most of the companies are IT-related. There are also some core placement opportunities. If you are well prepared, you can get opportunities easily. The highest package will be 9 LPA, the lowest will be 3.2 LPA, and the average package will be 4 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is sufficient for academic needs. Classrooms are not spacious, and they have basic facilities like boards and projectors. The campus is overcrowded. The quality of the hostel is very bad. They didn't allow non-veg in hostels during my period, but I heard that they changed it and are allowing it now.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: According to me, it is a good experience and a good place to learn and grow.

review_content.Placements: 80 percent got placed. One thing about REC is that they give specialized training for placements. They conduct summer and winter campuses from the 3rd year, making placement ready in the final year. The highest package is 14 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. Top recruiters include Cognizant, Accenture, Prodapt, CEI India, Hexaware, and KaaR Technologies. Nearly 20 percent got only an internship, and the remaining 60 percent got an internship plus PPO. The top roles are software engineer.
review_content.Infrastructure: Labs are air-conditioned. Wi-Fi is provided only in the hostel and labs. Classrooms are neat and clean, and the library is also good. Coming to food, it is nice and tasty. You have a variety of canteens inside the campus which you can use. Medical facilities are also good. Game tournaments are conducted frequently good practice is also given.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Business System - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: College offers a perfect blend of studies and campus life.

review_content.Placements: Around 75-80 percent of students got placed in my course. The highest package is about 12 LPA, the lowest is around 3 LPA, and the average package is 5.5 LPA. Recruiting companies like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, Cognizant, and Amazon visited the campus. About 60 percent of students also got internships in companies like HCL, Capgemini, and startups. The main roles offered are Software Engineer, Data Analyst, and Consultant.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college has Wi-Fi in classrooms, computer labs with good systems, and a library with many books and e-resources. The labs are updated and are useful for practical learning. Hostels are neat with basic facilities like cupboards, study tables, and 24/7 water. The mess food is average but hygienic, and the canteen has better options. We also have a medical room, sports grounds, a gym, and indoor games. Overall, the facilities are good for both studies and daily life.

REC offers admission to these courses based on the valid score of the entrance exam followed by either Counselling or Group Discussion or Personal Interview.

REC eligibilityfor all the UG and PG courses is entrance based, however, admission is offered on the basis the scores obtained by the candidates in various entrance exams accepted by the college. hostel_campus.college_name: Rajalakshmi Engineering College Infrastructure Details & Reviews

facilities: Library: The college library is house in a large, modern 9000-square-foot building. On all working days, the library is accessible to students and employees from 7:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. In all areas of Engineering, Science, Technology, Management, and General Studies, the library has a comprehensive collection of more than 52,600 volumes of textbooks, reference works, and national and international magazines, and the collection is constantly growing.

Canteen: The college has a fully working vegetarian canteen where employees and students can enjoy cleanly cooked food. The campus is also home to a funded mess. Boys have access to a separate mess area.

Hostel: There is a separate hostel for boys and girls on campus. There are 200 girls and 500 boys that can stay in the hostel. Final year and graduate students are provided with single rooms. Additional, candidates are allowed to use their personal computers in their rooms. The mess has a large eating room and kitchen. Both boys' and girls' seating are allocated separately.

reviews.review_heading: Overall a good college with good placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is sufficient for academic needs. Classrooms are not spacious, and they have basic facilities like boards and projectors. The campus is overcrowded. The quality of the hostel is very bad. They didn't allow non-veg in hostels during my period, but I heard that they changed it and are allowing it now.

reviews.review_heading: According to me, it is a good experience and a good place to learn and grow.
reviews.review_text: Labs are air-conditioned. Wi-Fi is provided only in the hostel and labs. Classrooms are neat and clean, and the library is also good. Coming to food, it is nice and tasty. You have a variety of canteens inside the campus which you can use. Medical facilities are also good. Game tournaments are conducted frequently good practice is also given.

reviews.review_heading: College offers a perfect blend of studies and campus life.
reviews.review_text: Our college has Wi-Fi in classrooms, computer labs with good systems, and a library with many books and e-resources. The labs are updated and are useful for practical learning. Hostels are neat with basic facilities like cupboards, study tables, and 24/7 water. The mess food is average but hygienic, and the canteen has better options. We also have a medical room, sports grounds, a gym, and indoor games. Overall, the facilities are good for both studies and daily life.

reviews.review_heading: Very good college to improve your knowledge and skills.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are neat and clean. Labs are also neat and clean. At Rajalakshmi Engineering College, the library is good. The hostel facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: Not only focus on academics, but also on other domains like sports, skills, etc.
reviews.review_text: Labs here have every facility, including the machines, components, electronic devices, and gadgets that are required to do the experiments. Devices are then and now checked for their efficiency and working, and changed and repaired accordingly.

reviews.review_heading: College review by the student in the college.
reviews.review_text: All good about the facilities and infrastructure available for our course and department. Food is moderate and the staff are above average. There was a health center in our college. They give a big opportunity in games and sports.

reviews.review_heading: College and placements are good. Getting a seat through counseling is better.
reviews.review_text: Information Technology and Computer Science have similar curricula. The hostel is just above average; 6 sharing beds in Habitat is okay, but the food was the worst. The campus is hygienic, with greenery around. The computer labs have basic facilities. Otherwise, it has good infrastructure, and there is a teachers' lounge.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with our chosen faculty. Improvements have been made this year.
reviews.review_text: Now non-veg is also available, but I think it's only for boys. I don't know about it clearly, but non-veg for boys for sure. Wi-Fi is not good in all surroundings. Only in some areas can we get a good connection. Quality teachers are available. More events like teaching events exist; if we use them in a fine way, we can shine for sure.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of good placement and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not top-tier, but good. Hostel facilities are also good, but the food served in the hostel is one of the worst. If you opt for the AC hostel. There won't be a non-vegetarian menu option for you, non-vegetarian food is provided in non-AC hostels for boys, but only 3 times a week.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Rajalakshmi Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is average, and food is also average. Classrooms are neat. Library is very neat and silent, and most of the useful books are available in the library. Canteen is also neat, and the food is average. REC promotes sports and games normally. Medical treatment is really good.

reviews.review_heading: Basically, placements are good in our college. I prefer students join this college for sure.
reviews.review_text: Our college facilities and infrastructure are very good. The hostel accommodation could be improved. They are cleaned daily. The food options in the hostel are repetitive and not enjoyable. It is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with the infrastructure and the playground.
reviews.review_text: The new hostel, the food, and the infrastructure are good, but the old hostel is not up to the level of average. Our course is very good and it makes our future bright, so that we can make our career in the best way. Many other students can easily crack the interview with their help.

reviews.review_heading: In the past year, most of the students got placements and some went for higher studies.
reviews.review_text: Two big laboratories are available in our college. Wi-Fi is available in every canteen, and network at every single lab. Many classes contain smart boards. I am a day scholar, I got partial good feedback from hostellers.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, solid syllabus, and needs better industry exposure.
reviews.review_text: Department facilities are smart classrooms with projectors, high-speed Wi-Fi, well-equipped AI & ML labs, and access to a central library with online journals. Hostel rooms are decent with 24X7 Wi-Fi and good maintenance. Mess food is average. Canteen has better options. On-campus medical center is available for basic health needs. It has large playground, indoor games, gym, and regular sports events.

reviews.review_heading: Overall good for all including extra-curricular activities.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides 24X7 internet lab, free Wi-Fi across campus and hostels, 1.155 Gbps dedicated leased line, and more than 2000 PCs/laptops with fibre-optic backbone. It has lecture-capturing system, interactive panel, LCD projectors, and smartboards in all seminar halls and classrooms. It has 244 total labs, including 113 computer labs, plus specialized research and center of excellence facilities.

review_summary.college_name: VJTI Mumbai Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good placements, supportive faculty, and active campus life.

content.Placements: I am from the B.Tech Electrical Engineering (2023–27 batch). In my course, around 70–75% of students got placed in the previous batch. The highest package was around 12 LPA, the average was around 4.5 LPA, and the lowest was around 2.5 LPA. Top recruiters included TCS, Infosys, Wipro, L&T, and a few core companies like Siemens. About 60% of students also got internships in companies such as Tata Power and Bosch. The top roles offered were graduate engineer trainee, software engineer, and junior design engineer.
content.Infrastructure: The college has well-maintained classrooms, projectors, and good Wi-Fi in labs and the library. Labs are updated with the equipment needed for electrical engineering experiments. The library is big with digital access, too. Hostel rooms are decent with proper ventilation, water supply, and 24/7 security. The mess food is average but hygienic. Sports facilities like cricket and football grounds, badminton, and indoor games are available. Medical facilities are also provided on campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Textile Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Strong academics, good exposure, and lively campus life at VJTI by Prabhu.

content.Placements: In the textile technology course at VJTI, around 65 to 75% of those women are generally placed through the campus and off-campus opportunities. Highest package offered in recent years has been around 8 to 10 LPA, with the average salary lying in the range of four to five, with the lowest package around 2.5 LPA. Some of the companies that visit are Reliance Textile and Century Enka.
content.Infrastructure: Textile Technology Department of College is well-equipped with specialized laboratories such as pinning, weaving, dyeing, printing, and textile testing labs, which provide students with hands-on industry-level exposure. The classrooms are spacious and fitted with projectors, and Wi-Fi is available across the campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: There are top-notch placements for all branches.

content.Placements: Around 90% of students get placed in the CE branch with a good package. Our college has a legacy and top-notch placement. Talking about overall placement, it is also great and one of the best in Maharashtra, after IIT Bombay, so you can consider admission with placement in mind.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is average. The PG hostel is top-notch, but not everyone gets that. The other hostels are around average, but they are affordable and budget-friendly, with fees around Rs. 22,000 for a normal hostel and Rs. 44,000 for a PG hostel. The food is below average.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Great college, one of the best.

content.Placements: Placements are really good. There is not a single day when the Training and Placement office is empty. Once the placement season starts in August, companies offering really good packages keep coming until the end of July. If you are good at what you like and what the companies demand, you are sure to get a job.
content.Infrastructure: Being a government institute, there is not much you can expect. The funds are not used where they should be. Most of the funds are used to pay the salaries of the contractual faculty. However, there are a few world-class laboratories where quality work is done. Most of these labs are industry-backed and are supported well by the institute.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Electronics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Best for placements, one of the top colleges for a reason.

content.Placements: You need at least 80% to get in. The minimum would be 6 LPA, but it could scale up to 13-20 LPA for companies like Tata, Infosys, etc. Currently, we are all interns at companies like Central Railway, BEST, Accord Electro Technics, TIFR, etc. The top roles offered are representative, event manager, and club representative.
content.Infrastructure: All classrooms and some sitting areas have Wi-Fi, and the network strength is very good. The library also has Wi-Fi, and it's vast—you can find any book you want from diploma to degree level. The sitting area is large and appears quite premium, I guess. The hostel is also very good and clean. The mess offers tasty meals, and the rooms are quite nice. For sports and games, the hostel ground is very large and well-maintained. We also have a gymkhana offering games like carrom, chess, and table tennis.

review_summary.college_name: Shoolini University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) (Lateral Entry) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: A place to relax and win in life.

content.Placements: It provides an easy package at our university. They confirm 100 percent placement offers. The lowest package starts from 3 LPA but can go up to 18 LPA. The highest package is 45 LPA, and it is none other than a brilliant student of Shoolini University. Our university provides us with a space to work and win.
content.Infrastructure: It has a very beautiful campus, no honking, no noise, it's all greenery, and peaceful with amazing place to sit and relax. Our hostel is so clean with amazing people working to keep it peaceful, with different events like marathon and yoga sessions in the morning.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The university location is great and peaceful.

content.Placements: 85 percent of students are placed. The highest package offered is 24 LPA, the lowest package offered is 1 LPA, and the average package offered is 5 LPA. Top recruiters are Accenture, Dell, HCL, and many more. 70 percent in AWS, Accenture, Hitachi, and ITC are some of the companies. Roles offered are senior software developer, General Manager, and AI developer.
content.Infrastructure: In our college, Wi-Fi, computer labs, and library are available. Top-notch classrooms, electricity, a purified water project, and research labs. Facilities in the hostel are good. The quality of food is nice, and a medical facility is available 24 hours a day at the nearby hospital. Sports and games are average.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Great infrastructure, updated curriculum, and more. Come if a remote location is not a problem.

content.Placements: The real data is that about 90% of all students got placed. The top package this year is about 12 LPA, the lowest is about 3 LPA, and the average package is about 6 LPA. There are no very big names among the companies (on-campus), and the top ones are TCS & Infosys. Most students got internships, including many completing their 1st year. Top roles are related to SDE, Data Science, and AI.
content.Infrastructure: The library is pretty big and useful, with a huge set of books. Wi-Fi is amazing (hostel excluded). You'll find exceptions even on roads while you are walking on campus. Classrooms & labs for this course in the AI building are unarguably one of the best in the country, not exaggerating. Hostel rooms are comparable to the ones from dorms of international universities, with the option of attached washrooms too. Even common washrooms are clean all the time as they're thoroughly cleaned several times throughout the day. Mess is pretty, and food is decent too. We have to pay extra for non-vegetarian food.

individual_reviews.course: BCA in Full Stack Developer - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Faculty members are knowledgeable and supportive, always willing to help beyond expectations.

content.Placements: The program offers decent placement opportunities with reputed companies visiting the campus. While core jobs are available students with good internships have a better chance. The placement cell is supportive but its outreach could improve. This time I understand that my college is good.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for my course is well-developed with spacious classrooms, projectors and access to labs with updated equipment. The hostel is clean and secure offering basic amenities like Wi-Fi and laundry though food quality can improve.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Excellent college and satisfied with the faculty.

content.Placements: Placement is 100%. The college provides good placement facilities and internship programs, including the opportunity to gain experience and knowledge. Different types of top companies appear for placement in different areas of expertise. In the agriculture course, different companies have different approaches.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for my course is quite good. It provides well-furnished smart classes with projectors. Different labs according to subjects are provided with the necessary chemicals and equipment. The different equipment is provided for good knowledge.

admission_overview.college_name: Shoolini University Course Admission 2025: Eligibility, Selection Process & Dates

paragraphs: Shoolini University is accepts admission on a merit basis and an entrance basis.The university admits nationally level exams such as SAT India, JEE Main, CUET, CAT, MAT, etc.Additionally, Shoolini offers an entrance exam, known as SU-SAT, in selectcourses.With more than 180 undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in fields such as Science, Engineering, Management, Commerce, Pharmacy, and Law,among others, students are offered a great choice.Lateral entry admissions and Summit Research Program courses in Engineering are also permitted in the university.

The University offers various courses in the fields ofEngineering, Law and Science etc. Students seeking admission must meet the course specific eligibility and selection conditions. However, the university also offers a BTech Lateral Entry course. The following table mentions the eligibility and selection for some of the popularShoolini University courses.
CUET UG/ SU-SAT/JEE Main/SAT India+ Faculty Interaction
The admission process at Shoolini University consists of multiple s, which are as follows.

1. Shoolini University Application Process 2025Candidates are required to apply online for all courses offered by Shoolini University. During the application, an application fee needs to be paid. For BBA, BCom, and MBA courses. Students can check the detailed Shoolini University fee structure here.

2. Selection RoundsShoolini University admits students based on various entrance exam scores such as CLAT, GMAT, MAT, etc., for various course admission such as BA LLB, BBA, BDes among others. For UG and PG courses, the selection criteria for PhD course admission is based on a multiple-choice entrance test and assessment of research aptitude through concept notes & faculty interaction.

3. Merit List & CounsellingBased on the candidates' performance in the selection rounds, the university prepares a merit list. Those who find their names on the merit list are invited to the counselling round. During this stage, candidates need to confirm their admission by paying the required fee.

National-level entrance tests such as the SAT India, JEE Main, CUET, CAT, MAT, and so on are accepted by the university. For particular courses, Shoolini University administers the SU-SAT, its own entrance exam. More than 180 UG, PG, and PhD courses in a variety of subjects are available at the institution, including engineering, management, commerce, pharmacy, law, and more. For the engineering branch, it also provides summit research courses and lateral entrance admissions. In addition, the Shoolini University Centre for Distance and Online Education (SCDOE) provides BBA, BCom (Hons), and other courses.

faqs.question: What is the last date of application form of Shoolini University?
faqs.answer: The online application window to apply for various courses at Shoolini University is open now. Till now, no schedule has been released by the university. Once the application portal is live, candidates can apply online for their preferred course. he admission to most of the courses is based on national level entranc exam score such as CUET UG, MAT/ CAT/ GMAT.

faqs.answer: Candidates must sit and appear for entrance examinations as per respective courses. Aspirants will be required based on the course selection criteria. nirf.description:
Shoolini University has been ranked well by the NIRF under the 'Overall' category. Through the years, the NIRF rankings for Shoolini University indicate the institute's strong performance in crucial areas such as the Quality of Education, Conducting Impactful Research, the Expertise of Faculty members, and Overall Institutional Management. These good rankings not only prove the institute's positive reputation but also highlight its excellence across diverse domains, evaluated against the standards established by the NIRF. When evaluated against the ranking of the past years, it has been noticed that in the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have shown a decreasing trend. In 2025, Shoolini University fell 12 ranks to #101 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
It has been seen that within the category of 'University', the institute's ranking has scaled up when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, Shoolini University climbed 1 rank to #69 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.
It is to be noticed that the institute has shown a fluctuating trend in the 'Engineering' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, Shoolini University fell 9 ranks to #101 rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking. Throughout the preceding two years, the rank has oscillated but is currently stable.
In the 'Pharmacy' category, the institute's ranks have shown a fluctuation when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, Shoolini University fell 14 ranks to #44 rank in the 'Pharmacy' category by the NIRF ranking.

reviews.review_heading: A place to relax and win in life.
reviews.review_text: It has a very beautiful campus, no honking, no noise, it's all greenery, and peaceful with amazing place to sit and relax. Our hostel is so clean with amazing people working to keep it peaceful, with different events like marathon and yoga sessions in the morning.

reviews.review_heading: The university location is great and peaceful.
reviews.review_text: In our college, Wi-Fi, computer labs, and library are available. Top-notch classrooms, electricity, a purified water project, and research labs. Facilities in the hostel are good. The quality of food is nice, and a medical facility is available 24 hours a day at the nearby hospital. Sports and games are average.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure, updated curriculum, and more. Come if a remote location is not a problem.
reviews.review_text: The library is pretty big and useful, with a huge set of books. Wi-Fi is amazing (hostel excluded). You'll find exceptions even on roads while you are walking on campus. Classrooms & labs for this course in the AI building are unarguably one of the best in the country, not exaggerating. Hostel rooms are comparable to the ones from dorms of international universities, with the option of attached washrooms too. Even common washrooms are clean all the time as they're thoroughly cleaned several time...

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are knowledgeable and supportive, always willing to help beyond expectations.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for my course is well-developed with spacious classrooms, projectors and access to labs with updated equipment. The hostel is clean and secure offering basic amenities like Wi-Fi and laundry though food quality can improve.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent college and satisfied with the faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for my course is quite good. It provides well-furnished smart classes with projectors. Different labs according to subjects are provided with the necessary chemicals and equipment. The different equipment is provided for good knowledge.

reviews.review_heading: This university is good for your overall development.
reviews.review_text: The college has modern infrastructure, and the hostels provide very good services, especially in my hostel, for village students. The boys' hostel is located off the campus, and the girls' hostel is on the campus. There is 24 hour Wi-Fi service available. The labs are good, and there is an Apple lab in the AI block.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and my college offers a great.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for my course is well-developed, with spacious classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, and well-equipped labs that support practical learning. The department also has access to a good library with relevant reference materials and digital resources. Hostel facilities are decent, with clean rooms and regular maintenance.

reviews.review_heading: It has great labs for research and a peaceful campus.
reviews.review_text: The campus is well-equipped with different facilities. For food technology students, there are advanced labs for research. The university itself carries many patients which helps a lot in research programs. It has modern classrooms with Wi-Fi ensuring a seamless learning experience. The hostel is good here. There is an indoor cafe built in girls' hostel. It has different games and modernized infrastructure which make it feel like our second home.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available are good. The washrooms are clean, classrooms are clean and spacious, and there is good Wi-Fi connectivity. The library is also amazing, open 24/7, 365 days a year, which is the best part. The hostel is also good, with good rooms, good food, and medical facilities available.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent campus and reliable faculty.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is very bad. Labs are not that bad. Quality of food is okay-okay. Some of the classrooms are very well-facilitated, and some are good ones. Good medical facilities are available. From time to time, game matches are held, and there is a sports complex with a gym also included in it.

reviews.review_heading: Strong digital marketing program with great placement and scenic campus life.
reviews.review_text: Our department has smart classrooms and high-speed Wi-Fi. The infrastructure is modern and well-maintained. Hostel is clean. The mess food is decent with a mix of dishes, and the mess offered good snacks. Medical facilities are available on campus, and sports like basketball, volleyball, badminton, and gym are also provided.

reviews.review_heading: The environment and atmosphere here are really good.
reviews.review_text: Well, I would say that the facilities are fairly good and good Wi-Fi speed, and libraries (study rooms) are there. Overall the facilities are good and the hostel is near campus. It is a very big advantage for me at the very least. Also, there are proper labs in my department.

reviews.review_heading: After so many days of worrying, I finally found my fit.
reviews.review_text: My department is very well equipped with laboratories which are really important for my course. Hostel facilities are at par, especially with the dead stories that I have heard from my older cousins. The hostel has been a relief. Moreover, they do listen. Feedback is taken often and acted upon.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the university for now.
reviews.review_text: They have high-speed Wi-Fi everywhere but in the AI block they have a speed of around 200 Mbps. The food is average and their cleanliness is maintained throughout the university. All the equipment is present in the labs and maintained by the university.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good, they do provide placements, and everything is amazing.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are good. I didn't opt for a hostel, so I don't know about it. There are clean washrooms, a 24/7 library, and good Wi-Fi. The classrooms are clean, and the food is average. Medical facilities are available, which are good. There are sports and games, a stadium, a basketball court, and a gym to stay fit.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college but overhyped.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is average because it is old. But the equipment in the laboratories is good enough. I would say our college library is one of the best libraries. Coming to hostels, washrooms are combined floor to floor. The hostel and mess food are quite good in taste.

reviews.review_heading: Overhyped college, but decent.
reviews.review_text: Each branch has separate labs and lab faculty members. There is only one library in this college, which is sufficient for students in each branch. It also contains different areas for different purposes, such as the internet, discussion room, etc. There is a canteen in this college which serves tasty and healthy food.

reviews.review_heading: One of the top colleges in EAMCET.
reviews.review_text: There are many good facilities in our college, like a gym and a proper ground. The food is very nice in both the hostel and the canteen. There are also good medical facilities. I loved the food more than the food prepared by my mom, as well as the canteen food.

reviews.review_heading: Decent college with decent placements.
reviews.review_text: We do have good facilities and infrastructure in our college, like everywhere you go, we have separate Wi-Fi for each floor in each block and spacious classrooms with digital projectors for interaction with students, and a big library, and we do have active club activities such as interactive sessions with professionals and experts.

reviews.review_heading: Really good faculty and a beautiful campus with greenery.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are too good in college like a large library, playground, college Wi-Fi for every block, classrooms are perfect, and laboratory for every subject is so advanced. College contains many canteens all over the campus, and the food is too delicious.

reviews.review_heading: The faculty is very nice and supportive. Infrastructure is good and very advanced. Big grounds.
reviews.review_text: College has a good infrastructure, including labs, classrooms, a big ground, and a big campus. Food in the canteen is also very good, it has many options.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with faculty, infrastructure, facilities, and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi for every block and for every 3 rooms. Excellent lab facilities for freshers and seniors. Decent infrastructure, better classrooms, and a wider library. The quality of the hostel is good. The quality of food is excellent, the medical facilities are good, and the facilities for sports and games are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Lower fees, many benefits, and better placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is pretty decent, with clean washrooms. Lab facilities are good, but can be a little better. The library is worth studying and upskilling. Some Classrooms lack the required number of fans. Hostel facilities are not bad. Mess food is better than any other hostel's. Sports facilities are better.

reviews.review_heading: Life of a middle-class as a CBITian - more expectations and more disappointment.
reviews.review_text: All is good like no hostel for girls but library is on point with free Wi-Fi. We have sports blocks, and we can play as much as we can. It will be open till 6:00 PM. We also have a gym where we can do as much as we can. Canteen is huge and have 300 people seating facility.

reviews.review_heading: Good academics with better placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is pretty decent, with clean washrooms. Lab facilities are good, but can be a little better. The library is worth studying and upskilling. Some classrooms lack the required number of fans. Hostel facilities are not bad. Mess food is better than any other hostel's. Sports facilities are better.

reviews.review_heading: The life of CBIT in short.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. They don't provide any hostel for the girls, but they provide a hostel for the boys, which is not on the campus but near it. As some of my friends are in CBIT hostel, they mentioned that the food is too good and nice.

reviews.review_heading: Decent but could be better.
reviews.review_text: We do have good facilities and infrastructure in our college, like everywhere you go, we have separate Wi-Fi for each floor in each block, spacious classrooms with digital projectors for interaction with students, a big library, and we have active club activities, such as interactive sessions with professionals and experts.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best colleges in Telangana that gives us a tag if students miss IITs or NITs.
reviews.review_text: College Wi-Fi is given to us from the 2nd year, which is changing on its last thread. Classrooms are a little old. The library will be mostly filled during exam time, and other times, I think normal people won't go there. The worst part of CBIT for me is that there is no girls' hostel.

reviews.review_heading: It’s the best college for the MCA course I have ever seen.
reviews.review_text: The amenities here are extremely decent, and the hostel accommodations are above average. There is no proper information on hostel rooms, but the hostel dining menu is below average. Hopefully, the food in the hostel will improve in the future. Students should be provided with clean food.

DY Patil Institute of Technology's admission process begins with registration for the course. Candidates need to qualify entrance exam specific to their course, and appear for the counselling process for their respective programme. Below are the steps to follow to get admission to the DY Patil Institute of Technology:
STEP 1: DYPIT Pune Application Process 2025

Candidates need to fill out the application form for the entrance exam accepted for their programme. For BE, candidates must apply for MHT-CET or JEE Main for admission. Aspirants already with a valid score in the entrance exam must wait for the counselling registration.
STEP 2: Selection

Once the registration is over, candidates can appear for the entrance examination. Candidates who wish to apply for B.E. must score a valid MHT-CET or JEE Main score. The selection for MTech course is largely based on the scores of GATE. MBA aspirants can become eligible for admissions purpose based on their XAT, ATMA, etc or MAH MBA CET scores.
STEP 3: Merit List & Counselling

The counselling authority will release the MHT CET merit list for the BE programme. Candidates need to register for CET Counselling conducted by the State Common Entrance Test Cell, Maharashtra. While filling out the counselling registration form, aspirants need to provide their college and course preference. Selected aspirants need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the institute.

reviews.review_heading: Short summary of Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute Of Technology.
reviews.review_text: College lacks a lot of facilities and infrastructure. In addition, the college campus is very small having only one straight road with a cafeteria or canteen whatever we want to say it. It is going through construction right now which is going to last for atleast 3-4 more year which makes it harder for children and reduces the campus.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good option. Placements are good, but the infrastructure may be disappointing for some.
reviews.review_text: Classroom conditions are average. They are mostly like our school classrooms. Wi-Fi is available in the college, but we have to submit a form to gain access. There is a library, but it has been shifted to another floor due to construction in the building.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, small campus.
reviews.review_text: The campus is very small (almost no campus except a library and a canteen), there is free Wi-Fi available for laptops, but you have to send a request to the college using the ERP portals for the same. The hostel is way too expensive, and many students prefer PGs nearby rather than living in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, supportive faculty, and a balanced campus life.
reviews.review_text: College has good infrastructure with Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a central library with a wide range of resources. Department provides access to project labs and seminar halls for presentations. Hostel facilities are decent with clean rooms and common areas. Mess food quality is satisfactory and hygienic, though canteen options are better. Medical facilities are available on campus, and sports facilities include cricket, football, basketball courts, and indoor games. Overal...

reviews.review_heading: Not much satisfied with curriculum, good placements for Software branches, and good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite good with all the facilities like water filters, Wi-Fi, library, study room, canteen, hostels, etc. The hostel fee is currently 2.2 lacs for one year. There is a 20% increase in the hostel fees every year. The mess food is also not good.

reviews.review_heading: College is decent according to placements, 85% placements, faculty and staff are average and good.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi provided but labs, classrooms, and library are provided. No mess for college students but canteen is provided. Annual sports fest and inter-college tournaments are conducted. It also conducts professional coaching (for selected sports). It has first-aid and sports injury assistance. Sports scholarships are also there for state/national players.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, placement, and education.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is so good but costly. I have no idea about food quality as I was in PGs and flats. You will be provided with plans like three sharing, two sharing, etc., also without food and with food. It has AC and rooms without AC. It also has Wi-Fi. Classrooms are way too good. Library can be improved.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good only for civil engineers.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is very good. All buildings and classrooms are properly on the campus. We have a canteen, but the price of the food is very high and outside the budget of students. Various types of food stalls are available, and the food from these stalls is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Not worth the money because of less practical knowledge and not being industry-ready.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and library have been provided. Hostel is very costly and well-maintained like a 5 star hotel but the food isn't that good and not worth the money because cooking facilities, gym, laundry nothing is available and has strict rules.

reviews.review_heading: Teachers are very good. Placement wise also it is a good choice.
reviews.review_text: Our department has decent Wi-Fi all over the campus. Classrooms have projectors and are good for lectures. Labs were well-equipped with PCs and required software. The library had a good collection of books and a digital section too. Overall, the infrastructure was good and supported learning well. I was not in the college hostel, and I was in PG.

reviews.review_heading: It is not worth the money, but the infrastructure is good.

review_content.Placements: Around 50-60% student get placed by the end of the year. The top companies are Wipro, Accenture, Infosys, Capgemini, Cognizant, TCS, and some product-based companies. The highest package goes up to 10-12 LPA. The average package goes to 4-6 LPA, and the lowest package goes up to 3 LPA. Common roles are Software Developer and Associate Engineer.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college has good infrastructure. Classrooms are spacious and equipped with projectors and Wi-Fi. Mess food quality is manageable but repetitive, and hygiene is mostly maintained. A medical facility is also available. The central library is well-maintained with a large number of books, journals and digital resources. Hostel facilities are average to good, with clean rooms and basic needs.

content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms are smart and modern. There is world-class infrastructure in our college. Hostel, food, and rest are all average to decent category. Medical facility is available in the college. Sports and games activity is available on the campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security and Forensic) in academic collaboration with IBM - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with the staff and management.

content.Placements: 97% of students are placed by the college itself only. The highest package offered is 60 LPA in Microsoft, and the average ranges from 5 to 9 LPA, while the lowest is 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Capgemini, Accenture, Cognizant, HCL, Hiresure, etc. Roles offered are sales, QA, SDE, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Overall, the infrastructure of the college is very good. All labs are equipped with separate Wi-Fi and a firewall to prevent misuse of Wi-Fi. The speed of Wi-Fi is very good. Facilities in the hostel are also very good. The food is given properly, and the health of students is taken care of very responsibly.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Analytics) in academic collaboration with IBM - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of GLA University.

content.Placements: Around 50-60% student get placed by the end of the year. The top companies are Wipro, Accenture, Infosys, Capgemini, Cognizant, TCS, and some product-based companies. The highest package goes up to 10-12 LPA. The average package goes to 4-6 LPA, and the lowest package goes up to 3 LPA. Common roles are Software Developer and Associate Engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has good infrastructure. Classrooms are spacious and equipped with projectors and Wi-Fi. Mess food quality is manageable but repetitive, and hygiene is mostly maintained. A medical facility is also available. The central library is well-maintained with a large number of books, journals and digital resources. Hostel facilities are average to good, with clean rooms and basic needs.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AIML) in partnership with Microsoft - Batch of 0
individual_reviews.title: Good learning experience with an active campus.

content.Placements: I am from the 2024-2028 batch at GLA University. Based on seniors' records, around 70-80% of students from my course get placed. The highest package goes up to around 10-12 LPA, the average is 4-5 LPA, and the lowest is around 3 LPA. Companies like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, Capgemini, and Cognizant visit the campus. Around 60-70% of students get internships with good faculty support. Common roles include Software Developer, Engineer, Trainee, and Analyst.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities for my course are good. Classrooms are clean and comfortable. Labs are useful for practical work and help us understand subjects better. Wi-Fi is available on campus, and the library has enough books and study material for students. Hostel facilities are okay and suitable for students. Rooms are decent and livable. Mess food is average but clean, and the canteen has different food items. Medical help is available on campus when needed. The college also has good sports facilities for games like cricket, volleyball, basketball, badminton, and indoor games. Overall, the facilities support both studies and student life well.

GLA University Mathura admissions 2025 are both merit and entrance-based. Candidates have to qualify for all the rounds of the selection process. Find below the detailed process around GLA admissions 2025:
Step 1: GLA University Mathura Application Process 2025

GLA University Mathura admission process 2025 starts with the application process. Candidates can download the application process from the university's official website. The duly filled application form has to be sent either through post or submitted in person at the concerned department at GLA University Mathura. However, the application and entrance test fee will be paid online and candidates have to attach the pay slip along with the two copies of the online bank challan with the application form.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Admission to all the PG courses at GLA University Mathura is entrance-based. Candidates have to qualify for either university-level or state-level entrance exams such as GLAET for the selection of respective courses. Furthermore, the university offers UG courses through its affiliated colleges. Admissions to UG courses are based on merit scores obtained in the last qualifying exam.
Step 3: Merit List Release & Counselling

After the completion of all the selection rounds, candidates have to appear for the counselling process for the respective courses. Later on, the university will release the merit list in various rounds of the selected candidates. Students who find their names on the merit list need to pay a certain amount ofGLA University Mathura feeto secure their seat.

reviews.review_heading: Genuine review from GLA University.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms are smart and modern. There is world-class infrastructure in our college. Hostel, food, and rest are all average to decent category. Medical facility is available in the college. Sports and games activity is available on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the staff and management.
reviews.review_text: Overall, the infrastructure of the college is very good. All labs are equipped with separate Wi-Fi and a firewall to prevent misuse of Wi-Fi. The speed of Wi-Fi is very good. Facilities in the hostel are also very good. The food is given properly, and the health of students is taken care of very responsibly.

reviews.review_heading: Review of GLA University.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good infrastructure. Classrooms are spacious and equipped with projectors and Wi-Fi. Mess food quality is manageable but repetitive, and hygiene is mostly maintained. A medical facility is also available. The central library is well-maintained with a large number of books, journals and digital resources. Hostel facilities are average to good, with clean rooms and basic needs.

reviews.review_heading: Good learning experience with an active campus.
reviews.review_text: The facilities for my course are good. Classrooms are clean and comfortable. Labs are useful for practical work and help us understand subjects better. Wi-Fi is available on campus, and the library has enough books and study material for students. Hostel facilities are okay and suitable for students. Rooms are decent and livable. Mess food is average but clean, and the canteen has different food items. Medical help is available on campus when needed. The college also has good sports facilities f...

reviews.review_heading: GLA University Mathura is a private university. It has many courses, like engineering.
reviews.review_text: GLA University Mathura has good infrastructure with campus Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, and a spacious library. Hostels are decent and clean, the mess food is average while medical and sports facilities are easily available and well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty, good placements, good infrastructure, and not-so-good facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are fairly good. Every department has its own Wi-Fi, and classrooms are also really well made. Each class has projectors and enough space. The library is also really well made and a nice place to study quietly and peacefully. Talking about the hostel, it also depends on one's adjustment qualities. But the food in the mess is good and sometimes not good too. Canteen food is better tasting than the mess hall food. Medical facilities are average. There is room for impr...

reviews.review_heading: Review of GLA University.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course. They provide us with 24/7 facilities, a modern classroom with a digital board and a projector. Computer labs were working generally. Hostel quality was good. All essential amenities are available on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Decent placements with good infrastructure, but students must build skills.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is quite good and well maintained. Classrooms are spacious, properly ventilated, and equipped with projectors. Labs for our course are decent with sufficient systems. Wi-Fi is available across the campus and hostels, but the speed may vary at times. The library is large and peaceful. There are two libraries on the campus: one central and one basic. Hostel facilities are satisfactory, with clean rooms and proper security. Mess food quality is average but manageab...

reviews.review_heading: GLA University is good for placements and overall personality growth.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The library, labs, and classrooms are fully air-conditioned and well-maintained. Wi-Fi speed on the campus is good. Canteens are hygienic and have a good menu at a good price. Medical facilities are pretty good. There is an ambulance service 24x7. Food in the mess of hostels is good and hygienic. GLA has many football courts, basketball courts, and a cricket ground. Students are encouraged to play sports by the department.

reviews.review_heading: Crowd with the aims and achievements.
reviews.review_text: Faculty members are good at college, provide detailed information about the syllabus and provide content to explore more about the practical implementation, hostels are good in infrastructure and canteens are too good, like malls, you can shop via card.

reviews.review_heading: A good college in terms of fest, events, and college life.
reviews.review_text: In my ECE department, there is hardly any lab missing. Every machine required in our course is present on our campus. Many of my friends live in the hostel, the hostel room quality is very good, but the mess food is below average, and also canteen food is not so good as per the price. Sports facilities are very good.

reviews.review_heading: Good if you want to explore yourself.
reviews.review_text: They are equipped with Wi-Fi, smart board, and electronics labs for practical experience of the theory they are teaching, and hostels have separate ones for first year and for all years, and the menu in all messes is the same, but messes for all hostels are different, and they also have wings.

reviews.review_heading: College has all the facilities, and also the faculty is very helpful.
reviews.review_text: Every department has its own classrooms and labs. Wi-Fi is provided throughout the college campus. Food quality in the canteen is also average. Medical facilities are provided. Sports facilities like basketball court and ground are also provided.

reviews.review_heading: College is awesome. It has a good placement ratio even in the COVID-19 pandemic.
reviews.review_text: Our college has the best infrastructure. It has high internet connectivity. Classrooms are neat and clean. The quality of food is awesome, and it has many different options. There is a clinic in college. There are good playgrounds for playing cricket, athletic games, and basketball. It also has a good sports trainer.

reviews.review_heading: Don't take admission in GLA University.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are okay, but the academic infrastructure is not good. Classes are old, facilities are not up to the mark, and hostel timings are very bad, specifically for girls. Classes get over at 6 pm, and girls' hostel timing is 6:30 pm, while boys' hostel timing is 8 pm. You can't leave the campus after 8, and you can't take parcels and food orders after 10 pm. There are no sports facilities and no extracurricular activities.

review_summary.college_name: DEI Agra Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Voc. in AI andRobotics - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the faculty and infrastructure, but the college life is not too good.

content.Placements: So, since I am in 2nd year, no one is placed, but the batch that passed this year had around 40 students, approximately and 10 have been placed. The highest package that my senior got is around 13 LPA, but he got off-campus placement, so I can't say college is good at placement.
content.Infrastructure: Well, the infrastructure has all the things needed for our course, all the labs, equipment, Wi-Fi, and we have a library in every faculty. The girls' and boys canteen is different, the boys canteen staff are rude, and the food is not enjoyable as well. Teachers are great, and the engineering faculty has IITs.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Completely satisfied with placements, good faculty members.

content.Placements: Almost all students get placed with an average package of 6 LPA, and the top recruitment companies are Honda, Tata, JSW Group, etc. The roles offered are GET, and you become an assistant manager in one year, so a decent managerial post is offered by companies, which is a white-collar job.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for the course is well-maintained, and the basic necessary infrastructure is provided for the course. The canteen is not very good, having very little food variety, but the books in the library are provided for every semester at a very basic price. In addition, you can issue books from the library using your library card.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: College is the best for middle-class students because it is affordable all over Uttar Pradesh.

content.Placements: Something 70% students got placed. Some construction companies hire students for internships at construction companies. In my course, we have a chance to get selected at SSC JE, it's an amazing government opportunity, and we have good selection jobs at companies as engineers.
content.Infrastructure: In Dayalbagh Educational Institute, classrooms are amazing with smart boards, and labs are fully equipped, the library is digital, and all kinds of books are available. Hostels are above average and have good facilities for all students, and are most affordable for all students.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Mechanical branch is very good. Dayalbagh provides 100 placements.

content.Placements: 100% of students were placed in mechanical engineering, automobile, electrical, electronics, and civil. The highest package offered was 6 LPA, and the lowest package was 3.50 LPA. Recruiting companies were Schlumberger, Maruti Suzuki, Honda, Eicher, and Volvo. 100% of students got internships in mechanical, automobile, civil, and electrical.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities were very good. Infrastructure was very good, and the maintenance was proper. The quality and facilities were very good. Hostel food was very good like home. Hostel fee was very cheap. Canteen food was also good. Medical facilities were available, and this was a very good college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Footwear Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: This college is amazing for middle-class students because it has the lowest fee in all of India.

content.Placements: Footwear technology from Dayalbagh Educational Institute gave almost 100% placement because in Agra, there are many leather industries and good opportunities to start our own business. Students gave their best for placement and to maintain the college's reputation.
content.Infrastructure: Dayalbagh Educational Institute gives best lab, library, and classroom experience for all students. On college campus, there are four hostels, junior boys' and girls' hostel, and senior boys' and girls' hostel.
content.Faculty: As I know, Faculty of Engineering faculties are such amazing teacher, the best teacher has lots of knowledge. Course curriculum is too relevant to students and prepares them for good industry experience. College exams are difficult because they are conducted as open-book exams therefore, exams are tough. The department of Faculty of Engineering is too kind and moral.

Candidates must visit the DEI official website to fill out the application form before the last date using the submission of Common Application Form which is available on the Institute’s websitehttp://www.dei.ac.in. Candidates can opt for the offline application form as well which will be available at the Institute Counter.
Step 2: DEI Written Test

The institute conducts written tests for the eligible candidates. Candidates must make the selection of the Examination Centre from where the candidate will appear for all exams during the tenure of the programme. The DEI written test will last for two hours and based on the course curriculum.
Step 3: DEI Selection process

DEI selection procedure includes the candidate's performance in Written Objective tests conducted by Dayalbagh Educational Institute, and Interviews. Besides DEI’s entrance exam, the deemed university also accepts admission through national-level entrance exams such as JEE-Main, CUET, and NATA, among many others.
Step 4: DEI final selection
Once the candidates are selected are called for final admission. Candidates must pay the admission fee and secure their desired course seats at the Institution.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in English - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Everyone promised placements.

content.Placements: Placement-wise, it was a stronger institution. For our discipline, companies such as PlanetSpark, Educare Ventures Private Ltd., Jessi Publications, and Ambitious Global Services were among the most promising and frequently discussed recruiters. Reputed schools like Podar International School and Rainbow International School also hired graduates from our program for various job opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: Smart boards were fixed in all the classrooms for creating interactive learning space. There would be a collaboration space available for the students to discuss and to take a practical assessment. A thing to be worried about in college was that they were charging a higher capital fee and there were no hostel facilities provided in the institution, they suggested some PGs outside the campus.

individual_reviews.course: BCA in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It's a really good infrastructure and facilities. Good for placements in top companies.

content.Placements: Approximately 60 to 80 percent of attendance is needed, and they are offering 6 LPA to 16 LPA in top companies. Internship in my course is nearly 60 to 80 percent of students. They offered top companies for placements like IBM, Accenture, Cipla, Deloitte, Wipro, Infosys, and various types of companies are offered in this college. You can learn the top roles about cybersecurity, AI, data analyst, data scientist, and more.
content.Infrastructure: 24/7 Wi-Fi for all hostellers and food for vegetarians and non-vegetarians are both available. There are separate hostels for girls and boys for their privacy. The canteen food is really good, they prefer sports and games, and they have neat classrooms, libraries, etc.

individual_reviews.course: LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied because of the good placement.

content.Placements: In our college, every year, 80 to 90 per cent of students get placed in law in high court, district court, cognizant, TCS, and many more. Top recruiting companies are High Court, TCS, Supreme Court and many more, and the roles offered here are trainee roles. The highest package is 12 LPA, the average is 6 LPA, and the lowest is 2 LPA. Every year, 80% of students get an internship in different courts.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and facilities are excellent in this college, plus Wi-Fi, and the labs are good, neat and clean. The quality of food is acceptable, plus hostel rooms are quite good for studying. Different kinds of sports, like cricket and football, are held in this college. Students love to eat delicious food here.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Very satisfying and trustworthy college.

content.Placements: I am from the 2021-25 batch. The coaching and placement cell provide proper guidance to get placed.
content.Infrastructure: The college library and hostel fees are really affordable. It is one of the best colleges with a huge playground. The canteen food is really good and hygienic. You can join this college with full confidence as it is truly trustworthy, and you will enjoy the campus. It also has a gym for workouts for hostel students.
content.Faculty: Exams are conducted in a very disciplined manner. The way of teaching and understanding of concepts by the teaching staff are really great. You should join this college, as you can trust the teaching staff. They will guide you on how to attend examinations and also help you prepare for them.

individual_reviews.course: LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with the placement and faculty.

content.Placements: Every year, 80 to 90% students get placed in our college in top recruiting companies. Top recruiting companies are Sealdah High Court, Subordinate Courts, TCS, Cognizant, Wipro, and many more. review_summary.college_name: IEM Kolkata Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Our college is very good. Environment and placements are also very good.

content.Placements: All students are placed properly in many companies. The average package is 3.5 LPA. About 70 percent of students are placed, and the average package is 4–5 LPA. TCS, Infosys, and Wipro are also very good in environment. It also gives us Pan India-based placements, which is helpful for us.
content.Infrastructure: We have a computer lab with proper equipment. We have a basketball ground where we all spend time. We also have the best Wi-Fi in the college. Every room has an air conditioning facility. Mike is also good in our classroom. Medicine is properly given by our teacher.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The review of the best college in Salt Lake Sector V.

content.Placements: A minimum of 50 percent get placed. I don't know the exact details yet about companies like TCS, Infosys, or GreyB. I don't know the placement record very deeply, but I've shared what I have heard, and believe me, they aren't false. This college places students in some of the world's top companies.
content.Infrastructure: The classes are really good with modern technologies. Labs are fully air-conditioned. I am not a hosteller, so I don't know if the medical facilities are good. The institution is very keen on sports and games. They often host events, sports competitions, marathons, and football tournaments, which make us feel very energetic after hectic exams.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: A campus for perfect discipline.

content.Placements: Though it's not yet time for my placements, it's being carried on from my seniors who have had placements. Placement history and ongoing placements are great. There are a variety of companies and numerous other openings, like future studies in M.Tech or MBA, etc. For those who will be appearing for government exams, they can opt for special training with no or bare minimum extra charges within the campus.
content.Infrastructure: The course and college infrastructure are good. There have been continuous complaints with the hostel, its food quality, and the quality of usage and drinking water of the hostel. There are no provisions for AC in the hostel as of November, 2025. During the summer, coolers are provided in rooms with extra charges per month. The hostel fee for 12 months needs to be paid in one go before the commencement of the session.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: IEM Salt Lake BCA: Strong placements, decent infrastructure, and good supportive faculty members.

content.Placements: College provides excellent BCA placements with reputed recruiters like Deloitte, TCS, and Infosys. Around 90-95 percent of students got placed with an average package of 4 LPA to 5 LPA, and top offers reaching more than 8 LPA. It gives placement assistance as well, so students feel free to take any help.
content.Infrastructure: Average infrastructure with basic labs and classrooms that need modernization. Hostel facilities are limited, with small rooms and average food quality. Libraries are good and updated with all required books. It's not good, at least in my opinion, it's a 3/5 rating.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The best private college. Good placements and the teachers are so helpful.

content.Placements: Placements are good this year. Also, if you maintain discipline and follow their instructions, we can get good placements. They also guide students who want to do higher studies or start a startup. They are too concerned about their students, the best college indeed.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is not so much fancy. The food quality of the hostel and canteen is very good. There are also good medical facilities available in the college sports zone, like a basketball court, which is also there. They organize sports tournaments, also interschool.

Recruiting companies are Cognizant, TCS, etc. In the Big 4, you can get internships. Roles offered are AI and ML engineer, analyst roles, developer roles, SDE roles, manager, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good. Not upto the mark but by far I'll say good. Small campus and things, you'll feel like you're still in school. Food quality is decent. Also, there's a cafeteria and canteen so you get food for really cheap and there are cafes too in front of the college so you will not face any problem. The hostel is outside the campus because the campus is very small like 5 acres.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Decent college, decent placement, average faculty.

content.Placements: Around 70% of students got placed. "Senco Gold" was the top recruiter with a 3.6 LPA package, and the lowest was 1.2 LPA. The top role offered was Sales Intern. 100% of students got an internship in various companies like Biskfarm, TCS, Senco Gold, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is satisfactory. Classrooms are clean and well-maintained, and basic facilities, such as the library, labs, and Wi-Fi, are available. The food is good, and both veg and non-veg options are available. The hostel is also very clean, and every basic need is available, like AC/Non-AC rooms with fan, light, gas for cooking, washing machines, and other essential things.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The college is surrounded by nature and greenery.

content.Placements: 70 to 80 percent of people from our previous batch are placed. The average package is 5 LPA and the highest package is 12 LPA. The whole batch is provided with internship. The faculty is great they provide you with trips and great skills that help you crack the internship easily.
content.Infrastructure: There is Wi-Fi available, the classrooms are pretty decent and the library has ample amount of books. The labs are pretty good. If we talk about mess food, they have lots of variety from veg to non veg.
content.Faculty: Teachers are very knowledgeable and hold a strong degree and will always try to help you professionally and personally. They will help you with literally everything. They have knowledge that will help you with academics. They provide great support and help you build the skill.

admission_overview.title: MAKAUT Admission Overview 2026
admission_overview.description: MAKAUT, also known as Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, offers UG, PG, and doctoral programmes. The courses cover the domains of Engineering, Science, Arts and Social Sciences etc. Admission process at MAKAUT is entrance based. MAKAUT accepts a few more state/ national-level exams for admission, such as WBJEE, PGET, UGC NET (including JRF)/ CSIR NET for admission to other UG, PG and doctoral-level programmes. The university also conducts its own entrance exam, JEMAT, for admission into MBA and MHA courses. Applications for all the offered courses are accepted strictly in the online mdoe. Offline applications are not entertained at all. The duration of most UG courses is three to four years, with PG programmes extending up to two years. Read on to know more aboiut eligibility, admission and application process, fees etc. at MAKAUT.

faqs.question: Can I change my college under MAKAUT?
faqs.answer: No, candidates do not have the option to change their college under Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology. If they wish to change, they are required to appear for the necessary entrance test again. However, a few articles on the internet mention that students can change their college after the first year but they are required to clear all the exams of the first year for the same. For better clarity on the subject, candidates are advised to reach out to the admission office of MAKAUT or the affiliated institute under the university.

faqs.question: Which exam is required for admission to BCA at MAKAUT?
faqs.answer: MAKAUT offers a full-time BCA programme. In order to get admission, students must appear for CET. It is conducted byMAKAUT WB. Candidates must have qualified Class 12 to appear for this exam.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for BSc courses at MAKAUT?
faqs.answer: MAKAUT offers a three-year BSc programme spread across various specialisations. Any student who has passed Class 12 from a recorgnised board of education is eligible to apply for BSc courses at MAKAUT. Moreover, the students seeking admission to the aforementioned course would be required to have a valid CET (conducted by MAKAUT) score.

faqs.question: How many seats are there for MSc in MAKAUT?
faqs.answer: MAKAUT offers a total of1548 seatsfor its MSc programme. These seats are distributed among more than more than 10 affiliated colleges of the university. Some of the colleges included are the Institute of Management Study, Guru Nanak Institute of Pharmaceutical Science and Technology, and more.

content.Placements: I am still in first semester, first year, but it has been assured that in CS department the placement is almost 100 percent, and the highest package is around 42 LPA for foreign placement and 38 LPA for domestic placement. Placement training is very good according to seniors.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are very neat and well maintained. Same applies to campus and washrooms. Teachers use smart board to interact with class and teach. Library and Labs are very accessible and make everything easy for students. Sports department are very good and facilities are also amazing.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good college for both studies and enjoyment. Placements are good, and you can have a good life.

content.Placements: Mostly, 80 percent of the students got placed. The highest package is 33 LPA, and it was a Japanese company. The average package is about 6 LPA, and the lowest is 3.2 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Capgemini, Infosys, Eurofins, Ancko Visteon, and many others. Roles offered in our courses are electronics engineer, VLSI Engineer, and embedded system engineer.
content.Infrastructure: We have the best infrastructure that any college can provide, 24-hour library facilities, including a digital library. Wi-Fi access for every student. Best labs, most of the labs are developed by recruiting companies, and classrooms are well-equipped with a digital board for every classroom and good ventilation.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Finally, our college is the best for placements. It provides 100% placements.

content.Placements: The average package is 6 LPA, and the maximum packages range from 15-20 LPA and sometimes, above 20 LPA. On the core side, one of the best company that hire students is Capgemini. The percentage of students who got internships from our course is 60%. Companies like SAP, LG, etc., hire students from the college. The top roles offered in our course are chip designer and software developer.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is available, like a gym, Wi-Fi, library, labs, and classrooms. The maintenance is very high. The food is excellent. Emergency medical facilities are available. The infrastructure and facilities will help thousands of students make an informed college decision.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: NHCE has a good placement percentage, campus life, and industry exposure.

content.Placements: I have just completed my first year, so I do not know much about placement opportunities in the college, but what I have learned from seniors is that the number of students who got placed this year was higher than last year. The highest package is 42.5 LPA, and the lowest package is around 4 LPA. The average package is 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Zscalar, Visa, Flexcar, Hitachi, IBM, Infosys, Capgemini, Cognizant, Deloitte, etc. Nearly 45% of students got internships from my branch in companies like VMware, Société Générale, etc., Top roles offered are full-stack developer, data analyst, etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: This is an amazing college for students to explore various opportunities.

content.Placements: I am studying computer science with data science. The topmost package for our batch is 25 LPA. Almost 75% of students got an internship offer and are excelling in various companies such as MathCo, Airbus, Nokia, and Rakuten. The top roles given are data analyst and data engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are huge and can accommodate up to 80 to 90 students with smart board facilities and projectors for all uses. The hostel food and the lifestyle are good and well-maintained. They make hygienic food and the all the medical facilities are always available 24 hrs.
